chunks: And Idris ibn Hilal narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

He was asked about a man who had relations with his wife during the month of Ramadan. He said: "He must give twenty sa's of dates; for that is what the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instructed the man who came to him and asked him about that."

key_terms.أَتَى أَهْلَهُ: Had marital relations with his wife.
key_terms.إِدْرِيسُ بْنُ هِلَالٍ: A narrator transmitting this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام.
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آل: The Messenger of Allah, whose precedent is cited as proof.
key_terms.تَمْرٍ: Dates, specified as the substance to be given.
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: The month of fasting in which the ruling applies.
key_terms.عِشْرُونَ صَاعًا: A measured quantity required here as expiation.

ai.seo_question: What is due upon a man who has intercourse during the day in the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a man who had intercourse with his wife during the month of Ramadan. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that twenty sa's of dates are due, and supports the ruling by citing the instruction of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in a similar case.
